spec_match.rationale: Contrasts a real timed CAPTCHA-style challenge with a real timed hasPrivateToken() call, which is the proposal's human-cost argument grounded in the actual API rather than a mock.

interactive.rationale: The tile puzzle is fully playable (start, select, submit, timed) and the token check is a live API call; verified a solved run in 1.2s and a 0.3ms check populating the comparison facts.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The card promises doing the puzzle, timing both halves, and the who-is-asked argument, all present.

edge_cases.rationale: Checking before solving, wrong tile selections, and the not-measured argument rows are all distinct honest states — the who-was-asked table explicitly says it is argument, not measurement.

references.rationale: Links https://chromestatus.com/feature/6210457816924160 and Private State Tokens material.

conformance.rationale: The feature suite ran 6 pass / 0 fail on Chromium 141 — the query methods and privateToken request option genuinely exist on this build, so the whole suite executes for real.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Chromium 141 headless (cloud, no chrome-devtools-mcp): played the puzzle to completion (correct in 1.2s), ran the token check (0.3ms, false), and confirmed the facts panel and honest pre-solve state; console clean, screenshots read.

telemetry_health.rationale: Loads demo-telemetry.js and logs the check timing and result.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables, tile buttons and facts panel styled from tokens, no static card.

accessibility.rationale: Tiles are real buttons, the prompt is text, results are aria-live, and the comparison facts use dl semantics.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: No horizontal overflow at 360x740 DPR3 (scrollWidth 360, screenshot read); the tile grid fits.

summary: Reviewed at http://localhost:3000/v154/private-verification-tokens/friction-you-can-measure/ with Chromium 141 headless (cloud, no chrome-devtools-mcp). Both halves of the comparison are real and were exercised: the tile puzzle was played to a correct 1.2-second solve and the hasPrivateToken() check answered false in 0.3ms, with the facts panel putting them side by side and the who-was-asked table honestly labelled as argument rather than measurement. Private State Tokens exist on this build, so nothing needed a fallback. Console/network clean bar the sandbox font-CDN artifact; no mobile overflow; feature /conformance/ ran 6 pass / 0 fail. Clears the bar with no follow-ups.
